title: Corporate Actions Registry Schema
description: Schema for the Corporate Actions Registry (actions.json). Defines the structure of corporate actions for financial instruments.

version.description: Semantic version of the registry data (e.g., 1.0.0).

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the registry was generated.

notes.description: Optional notes about the data generation process.

isin.description: ISIN of the instrument affected by the corporate action.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for the action. Should be unique across the entire registry.

action_type.description: Type of corporate action. MERGER is a placeholder in v1.0.0 and may not be present in data.

ratio.description: Split ratio (e.g., '10:1' for a 10-for-1 forward split, '1:10' for a reverse split).

amount.description: Monetary amount for dividend types (cash per share).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for monetary amounts (dividends).

announcement.description: Date the corporate action was announced.

ex_date.description: Ex-date: the date on which the security trades without the entitlement.

record_date.description: Record date: the date on which shareholders must be on record to receive the entitlement.

effective_date.description: Effective date: the date the action becomes effective (e.g., split execution date, dividend payment date, delisting date).

source.description: Name of the primary source (e.g., 'SEC EDGAR', 'Company press release').

source_url.description: URL to the primary source document (e.g., SEC filing, press release).

verification_source.description: Name of a secondary source used to verify the action (optional).

price_multiplier.description: Multiplier to apply to historical prices before the ex-date (e.g., 0.1 for a 10:1 forward split).

share_multiplier.description: Multiplier to apply to historical share counts before the ex-date (e.g., 10.0 for a 10:1 forward split).

cash_adjustment.description: Cash per share to add to returns (e.g., dividend amount).
